live.note: Limits are counted per service instance, so with N instances the service-wide ceiling is N times the figure shown.

guards.name: Evidence ledger
guards.detail: A claim stays in a report only if every evidence id it cites was returned by a tool call in the same run.

guards.name: Number check
guards.detail: Decimals and 3+ digit numbers in a claim must appear in the cited rows.

guards.name: LLM Critic
guards.detail: A second model checks that the cited rows support each claim; one send-back, then unsupported claims are listed as removed.

guards.name: Escalation guard
guards.detail: An escalation needs named accounts and two supported claims; otherwise it is downgraded to uncertain.

guards.name: Analyst approval
guards.detail: Agents never act on accounts. Approve, reject and escalate need an analyst and a written reason, and are written to the audit trail.

guards.name: Outbound webhook
guards.detail: Fires only after an approved escalation; it never leaves the process.

guards.name: PII redaction
guards.detail: Planned for P6. The data is synthetic and holds no personal data.
